## C5 — The Lenses: MEF in full

**Section intro:**

> Meta-epistemic means the framework is not another theory about the world but a map of the ways a world gets to be known. Its decisive claim: the positions gain no specific meaning on their own. Ground, definition, operation, pattern, context, synthesis — these names are retroactive, applied only after a lens has refracted the bare number into a domain. The lenses are not commentary; they are the only means by which the positions become knowable at all. Twelve of them, each anchored in a real tradition of human thought, each containing its own sixfold — seventy-two conditions of knowing in all. And because the map is complete enough to show what every lens reveals, it also shows what each conceals: most stuck inquiries are not short of information — they are operating with a repressed lens. Finding the missing lens is the framework's diagnostic gift.

**The twelve lens descriptions** (each card: description below + its six glossed sublenses from `research-mef-ql-brief.md` §3 / `grammar-data.js`; chromatic tonic in the header):

> **L0 — Quaternal** *(Jung–Pauli psychoid ground · Aether · tonic C)*. The hinge where archetypal number becomes epistemic act: the lens through which the mute positions first become questions. Jung and Pauli held that number occupies a unique psychoid station — the most primitive order in the mind and the most fundamental structure in matter. L0 operationalises this: the six questions ARE the six numbers in interrogative form. Reach for it when the shape of the question itself is the problem.

> **L1 — Causal** *(Aristotle · Icchā Śakti · Schopenhauer · Earth · tonic D)*. Why things happen, with all four of Aristotle's causes restored — material, efficient, formal, final — grounded below by absolute freedom and crowned by will. Modern thought privileges efficient cause and then wonders why purpose, pattern, and value keep returning as anomalies. Reach for L1 when the real driver of a situation is being misidentified, or purpose is denied while operating silently.

> **L2 — Logical** *(Nāgārjuna's catuṣkoṭi · Air · tonic E)*. The complete space of logical possibility: IS, IS-NOT, BOTH, NEITHER — and a fifth station, silence. Paradox is often not a failure of inquiry but a sign that binary framing has become too thin for the field. The tetralemma is this lens's instrument. Reach for L2 when a domain shows contradiction it cannot metabolise, or its official logic has hit its own limits.

> **L3 — Processual** *(Whitehead · Bergson · Water · tonic F♯)*. Reality as becoming: each moment an actual occasion that gathers its entire past, entertains its possibilities, achieves itself, and perishes into permanence as data for what follows. Reach for L3 when something is being treated as static while it is actually mid-concrescence — developing, emerging, on its way.

> **L4 — Phenomenological** *(Heidegger · Earth · tonic G♯)*. The structures of lived experience: thrownness, being-there, temporality, care, releasement. We never start as isolated minds connecting to a world; we are always already in one. This is the subjective entry aperture — reach for L4 when the problem first shows up as lived tension, mood, situation, or the transformation of the knower.

> **L5 — Para Vāk** *(Kashmir Shaivism's Vāk ontology · Aether · tonic A♯)*. Reality as living speech: consciousness articulating itself through four densities, from the supreme Word where knower, knowing, and known are one, down through vision and inner speech to full utterance — and the letters themselves as the powers that measure reality into form. Reach for L5 when moving from intuition to wording: when a naming must be found and made answerable.

> **L0′ — Archetypal-Numerical** *(Jung–Pauli numbers · Aether · tonic C♯)*. The night face of L0: the positions as numbers rather than questions — one through six as qualitative characters, each a dynamical ordering factor active in psyche and nature alike. Question is number in interrogative form; number is question-structure crystallised. Reach for L0′ when a hidden counting-logic needs surfacing — when the skeleton of an inquiry should become visible.

> **L1′ — Phenomenal** *(Jung's psychic functions · Water · tonic D♯)*. The night face of L1: causation seen from inside. Four functions — sensation, feeling, thinking, intuition — under two attitudes: a complete map of how consciousness takes up a world. Not a typing toy. Reach for L1′ when how participants actually feel, perceive, and intuit a field is doing work the causal account misses.

> **L2′ — Alchemical-Elemental** *(the element-bearing lens · Aether · tonic F)*. Where L2 expands logical space, L2′ shows what happens to a field worked through that space: dissolution, heating, sublimation, crystallisation. The elements are modes of transformation, ending in Salt — the fixed body, matter perfected. Reach for L2′ when contradiction must be metabolised, not merely stated.

> **L3′ — Chronological** *(Hegel · Marx · Foucault · Aion · Fire · tonic G)*. The night face of L3: process at the scale of history. Spirit moving through its seasons — emergence, fullness, decline, incubation — each cycle a spiral rather than a circle. Hegel read history as spirit coming to know itself; his inheritors turned the same lens onto power — Marx onto the material order that carries spirit, Foucault onto the institutions that quietly decide what counts as knowledge. What they share is the question this project keeps: what power does with an age, and what an age does to the soul living inside it. Reach for L3′ when a crisis needs diagnosing as autumn or winter, when inherited civilisational weather is determining the present — the lens under which the project's companion work reads the long history of power and the sacred.

> **L4′ — Scientific** *(Kuhn · the working loop · Earth · tonic A)*. The night face of L4: investigation made explicit. Observe, think, plan, build, execute, verify — with the standing reminder that no paradigm is frame-neutral. This is the objective entry aperture — reach for L4′ when the problem is a state-gap: something measurable, testable, fixable. L4 and L4′ are one encounter axis; most real work braids them.

> **L5′ — Divine Logos** *(the Johannine Word · Aether · tonic B)*. The night face of L5: the Word become personal, entering history. Beginning, revelation, creative power, wisdom, presence — and at its crown the project's own name: epi-logos, the word upon the word, the Möbius return into ground. Reach for L5′ when a synthesis must become public, historical, executable — when the work needs its name.
